entries.text: Come out, come out, wherever you are![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_01

entries.text: Yes! Found it! Here’s our little herb![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You and Arven found the\n[VAR 0xFF00(0008)][VAR 0x0109(0001)][VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: legend_0050_system_01

entries.text: This shape! This sheen! It looks like it’ll taste\nhorrible, which means it’s gotta be good for you![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_04

entries.text: Now then, let’s see... What does the book have\nto say?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_05

entries.text:
It says here that the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sweet Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is good
for gut health and that it helps aid digestion.\c
Says it’s great for stomachaches, too, or when
you want to stimulate the ol’ appetite![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_a

entries.text:
Well, apparently [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Salty Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] helps with
aching hands and feet. Good for neuropathy and
numbness.\c
When you’ve got muscle weakness, it supposedly
builds up strength again![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_b

entries.text:
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Bitter Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]’s great for your circulation!
It really gets the blood flowing!\c
And that warms you right up, nice and toasty,
even boosting the immune system!\c
...Or so it says.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_c

entries.text:
OK, [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sour Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] is chock-full of nutrients
and is great for boosting your overall health!\c
Says here it works wonders whether you’re tired
physically or mentally. Perks you right up![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_d

entries.text:
So it seems [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Spicy Herba Mystica[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]’s supposed to
boost your metabolism!\c
It gives your circulation a boost and helps flush
out all those toxins...along with a ton of sweat![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_e

entries.text: No time to waste—let’s get some food going![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_06

entries.text: Yeeeaaarrrt! Hiya! Huwatcha![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_11

entries.text: Sorry for the wait!\c\nHere’s a super healthy sandwich that’ll perk\nyou right up once you eat it![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_07

entries.text: Plus, as a token of our friendship, here’s another\nTitan Badge! Gaze upon it in awe as you eat.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_08

entries.text: Gias!
entries.label: legend_0050_legend_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Do you want to give your sandwich\nto [VAR 0x0101(0001)]?
entries.label: legend_0050_system_02

entries.text: I’ll share!
entries.label: legend_0050_select_01

entries.text: This is mine...
entries.label: legend_0050_select_02

entries.text: Giaaawn...
entries.label: legend_0050_legend_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Maybe you want to give your sandwich to\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)]\r\nafter all?
entries.label: legend_0050_system_03

entries.text: Gians!
entries.label: legend_0050_legend_03

entries.text: Come on out, Mabosstiff! Food’s up![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_09

entries.text: *munch munch munch*
entries.label: legend_0050_mastiff_01

entries.text: Oh-ho-ho! Would you look at that! Seems like\nsomeone’s got a proper appetite now![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_10

entries.text: *chomp chomp* *snarf* *chomp*
entries.label: legend_0050_legend_04

entries.text: Agiaaas!
entries.label: legend_0050_legend_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to dash now!
entries.label: legend_0050_system_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to jump\nhigher now!
entries.label: legend_0050_system_05

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to glide now!
entries.label: legend_0050_system_06

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to move across the\nwater now!
entries.label: legend_0050_system_07

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to climb up
vertical
surfaces
now!
entries.label: legend_0050_system_08

entries.text: Seems like that fellow’s also slowly regaining its\noriginal strength.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_12

entries.text: Still...doesn’t look like it’s anywhere close to\nreturning to its battle form.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_13

entries.text: Giaaas...
entries.label: legend_0050_legend_07

entries.text: It seems healthy enough physically...\c\nMaybe it’s got some kind of mental block that’s\npreventing it from returning to its true form?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_14

entries.text: A mental block?
entries.label: legend_0050_select_03

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.label: legend_0050_select_04

entries.text: I’ve read about it in books before...\c\nA mental scar. Like psychological trauma,\nyou know? I think that’s what you call it.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_15

entries.text: Maybe it had a terrifying experience in battle,\nso now it’s scared to battle at all?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_19

entries.text: Well, don’t worry! I’m sure both that brute and\nMabosstiff will make a full recovery eventually![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_16

entries.text: So, how do you feel, Mabosstiff? How’s that\nHerba Mystica working?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_17

entries.text: Ruuuf...
entries.label: legend_0050_mastiff_03

entries.text: Gah! Uhhh, no pressure![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_18

entries.text: Not like it’s fair to expect every kind of Herba\nMystica to have some huge effect, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_28

entries.text: And it’s not like the effect has to be immediate,\neither.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_29

entries.text: Ba-ruf...
entries.label: legend_0050_mastiff_04

entries.text: Hey, it’s OK! Don’t worry![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_22

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)] and I are gonna make
sure
you’re
right
as rain![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: We’ve got one more herb to go...and I bet it’s\nthe best of them all![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_24

entries.text: It’s...it’s just gotta be.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_25

entries.text: All right, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\c\nThe next stop on our little herb hunt should be\nthe last![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0050_friend_26

entries.text: But we can’t lose steam until we’re done!\nLet’s keep up our momentum! Here! We! Go![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
